decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top: 0cm; margin-right: 0cm; margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The proposal, by reason of its back-land siting in the
rear garden, subdivision of the existing rear garden of 142 Malvern Avenue and
its habitable function, would represent an inappropriate form of development,
at odds with the character of the area and the prevailing pattern of
development in the locality, and would be detrimental to the visual amenities
of the neighbouring occupiers when viewed from their private garden areas;<span lang="EN-US" style=""> and would result in an undue increased level of
disturbance to the occupiers of the surrounding properties</span>,
contrary to P<span lang="EN-US" style="">olicy </span>D3
(D(1), D(7) and D(11)) <span lang="EN-US" style="">of The London Plan (2021)</span>, policy CS1.B of
the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), policy DM1 of the Harrow Development
Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and adopted Supplementary Planning
Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top:0cm;margin-right:0cm;margin-bottom:0cm;
margin-left:18.0pt;mso-add-space:auto;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:
none;text-autospace:none"><font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top: 0cm; margin-right: 0cm; margin-bottom: 10pt; line-height: normal;">The proposal, by reason of poor outlook to a sunken
terrace for the bedroom within the basement&nbsp;
would result in a substandard quality of living accommodation for future
occupiers&nbsp; contrary to the high quality
design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policy
D6.C of the London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.B of the Harrow Core Strategy
(2012), Policy DM1 of the Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013),
The Mayor of London Housing Supplementary Planning Guidance (2016) and the
adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top: 0cm; margin-right: 0cm; margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span lang="EN-US" style="">The proposal,
by reason of its siting and encroachment on private rear garden area, would
constitute Garden Land Development and would be at odds with the Councils
spatial strategy for growth</span> and<span lang="EN-US" style=""> would therefore harm its implementation and
sustainable growth of the Borough and would harm the contribution that gardens
make to the character of the area, contrary to the National Planning Policy
Framework (20</span>23<span lang="EN-US" style="">), Core </span>p<span lang="EN-US" style="">olicies CS1.A and CS1.B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and the
adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Garden Land Development (2013).&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:
&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-font-kerning:0pt"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top: 0cm; margin-right: 0cm; margin-bottom: 10pt; line-height: normal;">The proposal, by reason of its siting and cramped layout
within its plot, would interrupt the strong front building line, would fail to
provide a suitable setting for the dwelling, and a poor relationship with the
neighbouring properties and the public pavement. In addition, by reason of the
proposal’s poor design, siting and lack of relationship to the architectural
pattern of the street and together with the proposed basement, would result in
an incongruous and obtrusive development within the streetscene, which would be
inappropriate in the context of the established open character of the
properties in the area; and would be out of keeping with the distinctive
pattern of local development. The proposal would therefore fail to comply with
the high design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework
(2023),&nbsp; policy&nbsp; D3 (D(1) and D(11)) of The London Plan
(2021), Core Policy CS1.B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), policy DM1 of the
Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted
Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>
description: Redevelopment to provide single storey (1 bed) detached dwelling in rear garden with basement level; parking; bin and cycle stores
